papers.title: [Conversion to open surgery and short-term outcomes of laparoscopic versus robot-assisted minimally invasive definitive surgery for chronic radiation enteropathy].
papers.summary: The planned robotic approach is associated with a lower conversion rate to open surgery compared with the planned laparoscopic approach. Among patients completing minimally invasive surgery, robotic surgery is performed on cases with higher complexity and consumes more medical resources, without an increase in postoperative complications.

papers.title: Affordance-based robot manipulation with flow matching
papers.summary: We present a framework for assistive robot manipulation that addresses two fundamental challenges: efficient adaptation of large-scale models for scene affordance understanding and effective learning of robot actions by grounding the visual affordance. To tackle the first challenge, we adopt a parameter-efficient prompt tuning method, prepending learnable text prompts to a frozen vision model to predict affordances, while considering spatial and semantic relationships in multi-task scenarios. papers.title: Scale-free Niche Construction: expanding agent-microenvironment co-development to unconventional substrates
papers.summary: Niche construction emphasizes the active aspect of life forms that alter their environment via feedback loops in which that environment inevitably changes their behavior, structure, and future evolution. We argue that this powerful dynamic is general, extending far beyond typical applications in ecology and evolutionary biology. We explain how niche construction extends the scope of classical predictive and control loops beyond the nervous system and organism-level. papers.title: Underwater Robotic Joint (URJ) - CAD design files
papers.summary: CAD design files (STEP format), fabrication drawings, and a 3D-printable component (STL) for the Underwater Robotic Joint (URJ), a depth-rated, modular actuation unit for underwater manipulators, grippers, and legged robots. Part of the Open Toolkit for Underwater Actuation and Bio-inspired Robotics. Includes custom components (canister, front/rear caps, shaft) with fabrication drawings, standard/commercial parts used in assembly, and one 3D-printed part. Software and full system documentation: https://github.com/gpicardi/Open-Toolkit-for-Underwater-Actuation-and-Bio-inspired-Robotics

papers.title: Control and Power Management Electronics — PCB design files
papers.summary: Schematic, PCB layout, Gerber fabrication files, 3D models (OBJ), and bill of materials for the control and power management electronics of the Open Toolkit for Underwater Actuation and Bio-inspired Robotics. Includes the main board (Raspberry Pi 4-based, motor/sensor control, RS-485, ROS 2 integration) and the battery/power management board (power distribution, overcurrent protection). Software and full system documentation: https://github.com/gpicardi/Open-Toolkit-for-Underwater-Actuation-and-Bio-inspired-Robotics

papers.title: Maximizing area coverage for multi-robots using cloud
